name: Shadeling
description: The smallest and most common Hollow expression. A smear of wrongness that drifts along the ground.

attacks.name: Corrosive Touch
attacks.special: Organic materials (wood, leather) take double damage

passives.name: Amorphous
passives.description: Can move through spaces as narrow as 1 inch. Cannot be grappled or restrained.

passives.name: Corruption Trail
passives.description: Organic surfaces crossed take 1 necrotic damage. Leaves visible marks.

passives.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
passives.description: In direct sunlight: disadvantage on attacks and -2 AC.

hollow.veil_effect: Ambient sounds thin in 10 ft radius. Birdsong stops.

behavior.tactics: No tactics. Drifts toward nearest life energy. Clusters naturally but does not coordinate.
behavior.morale: fights_to_death

narration.first_sighting: A wet hiss skims the ground. A shapeless smear of darkness trails withered grass.
narration.attack_cue: A static hiss presses close as its whole form reaches for you. Its touch burns cold.
narration.wounded_cue: A thin crackle breaks as the shadeling shudders and its edges dissolve.
narration.death_cue: A brief hiss escapes as it disperses into black mist. The ground beneath is grey and dead.
narration.ambient_cue: A low hum swallows birdsong beside a patch of moving shadow. The grass beneath it is dying.

name: Hollowmoth
description: Airborne drift expressions. Patches of visual and auditory distortion that flutter in erratic patterns.

attacks.name: Distortion Flutter
attacks.special: No real damage. On hit: target has disadvantage on next Perception check

passives.name: Swarm Signal
passives.description: Where hollowmoths gather, stronger Hollow follows within 1d4 hours. DM receives a staging cue to prepare the next encounter.

passives.name: High-Frequency Whine
passives.description: All creatures within 30 ft: -1 to Concentration checks. Stacks with multiple moths (max -3).

passives.name: Drawn to Life
passives.description: Hollowmoths cluster around the creature with the highest current HP in range.

actives.name: Blinding Swarm
actives.description: All creatures in 10 ft: DEX save DC 10 or Blinded for 1 round. The swarm coalesces into a disorienting cloud.
actives.narration_cue: The swarm coalesces into a disorienting cloud.

hollow.veil_effect: Barely perceptible high-frequency whine. Faint melodic patterns almost resolve into language but never quite do.

behavior.tactics: No aggression. Swarms around living creatures. Real danger is as a warning signal and debuff.
behavior.morale: scatters_if_half_killed

narration.first_sighting: A high whine catches in your ears. Patches of air flutter at the edge of vision a fraction too slowly.
narration.attack_cue: A papery rustle passes through you. Colors smear and edges blur, then snap back.
narration.wounded_cue: A sharp squeal cuts the air, and the moth flutters on as if untouched.
narration.death_cue: A tiny snap sounds as the moth blinks out. One less wrongness hangs in the air.
narration.ambient_cue: A soft papery flutter and a whine just below hearing tighten your jaw.

audio.ambient: papery flutter loop + HLW high-frequency whine

name: Grey Wolf
description: A grey hunting wolf that tracks prey in coordinated packs.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.special: DC 11 STR save or knocked prone

passives.name: Pack Tactics
passives.description: Advantage if an ally is within 5 ft of the target.

passives.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
passives.description: Advantage on related Perception checks.

behavior.tactics: Packs surround prey. Target prone creatures. Retreat if alpha falls.
behavior.morale: Flees at half pack size.

narration.first_sighting: A low howl rolls through the brush, answered from both sides of the trail. Grey shapes close the gap.
narration.attack_cue: A growl breaks into a sharp snap as the wolf lunges for your leg.
narration.wounded_cue: A yelp cuts short, then the wolf backs away with its ears flat.
narration.death_cue: A last whine fades into the grass as the pack goes quiet.
narration.ambient_cue: Soft panting passes through the undergrowth, first near, then farther off.

audio.ambient: soft panting and paws in leaf litter

name: Wild Boar
description: A territorial wild boar that charges intruders and guards its range.

attacks.name: Tusk
attacks.special: If charged 15+ ft before attack: +1d6 damage

passives.name: Relentless
passives.description: 1/day, if reduced to 0 HP by an attack dealing 7 or less damage, drop to 1 HP instead.

passives.name: Charge
passives.description: Bonus damage after moving 15 ft before a tusk attack.

behavior.tactics: Territorial. Charges at intruders. Does not pursue beyond territory.
behavior.morale: Fights to death defending territory. Flees if encountered outside territory.

narration.first_sighting: A rough snort comes from the thicket, followed by the scrape of hooves on hard earth.
narration.attack_cue: A squeal rises as the boar drives its tusks toward you.
narration.wounded_cue: A grunt shakes its broad chest, but it plants its feet again.
narration.death_cue: A final breath rattles through its teeth before the brush falls still.
narration.ambient_cue: Snuffling and the smell of churned soil drift from the field edge.

name: Giant Spider
description: A ceiling-climbing spider that traps prey in webbed ruins and caves.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.special: DC 12 CON save or Poisoned 1 hour + 1d6 poison damage

attacks.name: Web
attacks.special: Target Restrained (STR DC 12 or slash through, AC 10, 5 HP)

passives.name: Spider Climb
passives.description: Climb 30 ft on surfaces including ceilings.

passives.name: Web Sense
passives.description: Knows location of any creature touching its web.

passives.name: Darkvision
passives.description: Darkvision 60 ft.

behavior.tactics: Ambush predator. Webs exits, waits on ceiling, drops on webbed prey. Climbs 30 ft. Retreats to web if threatened in open.
behavior.morale: Flees if web is destroyed.

narration.first_sighting: A dry click comes from above, then another answers from inside the web.
narration.attack_cue: A hiss of silk cuts across the passage as the spider casts its web.
narration.wounded_cue: A chittering rasp follows the blow, and its legs draw close.
narration.death_cue: A brittle crunch ends in silence as the web slackens.
narration.ambient_cue: Soft clicks travel overhead while silk brushes the stone.

audio.ambient: dry clicks and taut silk creaking
audio.attack: hiss of a lunge or cast web

name: Bandit
description: An armed road robber who ambushes travelers and bargains when outmatched.

actives.name: Dirty Fighting
actives.description: 1/encounter: throw dirt or sand. Target is Blinded for 1 round unless it passes a DEX save DC 12.
actives.narration_cue: Dirt scatters with a dry hiss before the target cries out.

behavior.tactics: Ambush from cover. Focus downed targets. Demand surrender before attacking if outnumbered.
behavior.morale: Flees at half HP or if leader falls. Surrenders if clearly outmatched.
behavior.group_size: Gang of 3-6, often with 1 Bandit Captain (Tier 2)

narration.first_sighting: Leather creaks beyond the bend, and a crossbow string draws tight.
narration.attack_cue: A bowstring twangs as the bandit fires from cover.
narration.wounded_cue: A grunt escapes through clenched teeth as the bandit staggers.
narration.death_cue: A sword clatters on stone, followed by one last breath.
narration.ambient_cue: Low whistles trade between the trees on either side of the road.

name: Thornveld Stalker
description: A tree-climbing forest predator that pounces on isolated travelers.

attacks.name: Pounce
attacks.special: Requires 20 ft movement. Target DEX save DC 13 or knocked prone. If prone: free bite attack (1d6+3)

passives.name: Keen Smell
passives.description: Advantage on Perception checks by smell.

passives.name: Forest Camouflage
passives.description: Advantage on Stealth in forest terrain.

behavior.tactics: Ambush predator. Climbs 20 ft, stalks from trees, and pounces on isolated targets. Will not attack groups of 4+.
behavior.morale: Flees if first pounce fails.

narration.first_sighting: A branch creaks above you, then comes the smell of wet fur.
narration.attack_cue: A sharp growl drops from the canopy as claws rake forward.
narration.wounded_cue: A yelp turns to a rasp, and the stalker scrambles for height.
narration.death_cue: A final breath catches in its throat before the branches settle.
narration.ambient_cue: Leaves rustle overhead, though the air at ground level is still.

name: Corrupted Treant
description: A Hollow-touched grove guardian whose roots choke the ground around it.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.special: Target pushed 10 ft

attacks.name: Thorn Barrage
attacks.special: DEX save DC 14. 15 ft cone. Half on success

passives.name: Vulnerability to Fire
passives.description: Takes double fire damage.

passives.name: Resistance
passives.description: Resists bludgeoning and piercing damage.

passives.name: Rooted Aura
passives.description: Plants within 30 ft grow aggressively; the area is difficult terrain.

actives.name: Entangling Roots
actives.description: All creatures within 15 ft: STR save DC 14 or Restrained. The ground erupts with roots.
actives.narration_cue: Roots crack through the earth and coil around nearby legs.

behavior.tactics: Territorial guardian of corrupted groves. Twisted by proximity to Hollow corruption; still natural, but warped and hostile. Prioritizes fire-users as threats.
behavior.morale: Fights to death defending its grove. Will not pursue beyond 100 ft of its tree.
behavior.group_size: Solitary (guarding 2-3 normal trees that are its grove)

narration.first_sighting: Wood groans deep in the grove, and sour rot cuts through the pine scent.
narration.attack_cue: Roots crack underfoot as the treant swings a heavy limb.
narration.wounded_cue: A splintering snap rings out while dark sap seeps from its trunk.
narration.death_cue: A long creak subsides into silence as the great trunk falls.
narration.ambient_cue: A slow grinding sound moves from tree to tree beneath the smell of spoiled sap.

audio.attack: groaning limb swing and root crack

name: Steppe Razorwing
description: A sharp-winged hunter that dives from the open highlands.

attacks.name: Talons
attacks.special: On hit from a dive (30+ ft descent): +1d6 damage

attacks.name: Wing Slash
attacks.special: Can target two adjacent creatures

passives.name: Flyby
passives.description: Doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when flying away.

passives.name: Keen Sight
passives.description: Advantage on Perception checks by sight.

behavior.tactics: Dive-attacks from height. Targets small or isolated creatures. Retreats to altitude between attacks.
behavior.morale: Flees after taking any damage (unless defending nest).

narration.first_sighting: A shrill whistle cuts through the high wind above you.
narration.attack_cue: A wing snaps in the wind as talons rake downward.
narration.wounded_cue: A harsh screech breaks off as its flight falters.
narration.death_cue: A last whistle thins into the wind as feathers settle.
narration.ambient_cue: Wingbeats rustle overhead in the open air.

name: Steppe Bison
description: A powerful herd beast of the Drathian grasslands.

attacks.name: Gore
attacks.special: If charged 20+ ft: target STR save DC 14 or knocked prone and Stunned 1 round

passives.name: Stampede
passives.description: If 3+ bison charge in the same direction, all creatures in the path: DEX save DC 14 or 2d8 bludgeoning damage and knocked prone.

behavior.tactics: Herd animal. Normally docile. Panics and stampedes when threatened. Individual bison charge only when cornered or defending calves.
behavior.morale: Stampedes away from danger. Individual fights to death only if cornered.

narration.first_sighting: Heavy hoof thuds roll across the grass.
narration.attack_cue: A furious snort precedes the charge.
narration.wounded_cue: A pained grunt rises above the pounding herd.
narration.death_cue: A final breath rattles as the massive body falls.
narration.ambient_cue: Low grunts and hoof thuds travel across the plain.

name: Rock Viper
description: A small venomous snake concealed among mountain stones.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.special: On hit: +1d6 poison damage. DC 11 CON save or Poisoned 1 hour. Failed by 5+: Paralyzed 10 min

passives.name: Camouflage
passives.description: Advantage on Stealth checks in rocky terrain.

passives.name: Tiny
passives.description: Can hide in cracks and crevices. Climbs 20 ft.

behavior.tactics: Ambush. Hides in rocks, strikes exposed ankles or hands. Does not pursue.
behavior.morale: Flees immediately after striking.

narration.first_sighting: A dry hiss leaks from between the stones.
narration.attack_cue: A sharp hiss accompanies a strike at your ankle.
narration.wounded_cue: A thin rasp escapes as it recoils into a crack.
narration.death_cue: Its last hiss fades beneath the scrape of loose grit.
narration.ambient_cue: Pebbles scrape and a faint hiss answers from the rocks.

name: Cave Wyrm
description: A hungry scaled predator that tunnels through mountain caves.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.special: On crit: target grappled (escape DC 14)

attacks.name: Tail Sweep
attacks.special: DEX save DC 14 or knocked prone. Reach 10 ft

attacks.name: Acid Spit
attacks.special: Recharge 5-6. DEX save DC 13 for half. Corrodes metal armor (-1 AC until repaired)

multiattack: 2 attacks — one Bite and one Tail

passives.name: Tremorsense
passives.description: Detects movement through ground within 30 ft.

passives.name: Darkvision
passives.description: Darkvision 60 ft.

passives.name: Scales
passives.description: Resists acid damage. Climbs 30 ft and burrows 10 ft.

behavior.tactics: Ambush from tunnel walls or ceiling. Uses tremorsense to detect approaching prey. Fights aggressively — cave wyrms are always hungry.
behavior.morale: Fights to 25% HP, then attempts to burrow and escape.

narration.first_sighting: A deep rasp rolls through the tunnel walls.
narration.attack_cue: Stone cracks under its claws as jaws lunge forward.
narration.wounded_cue: A guttural growl echoes off the cave roof.
narration.death_cue: A final rattling breath fades into the deep passage.
narration.ambient_cue: Claws scrape the rock beyond the bend.

name: War Golem
description: An ancient stone and steel guardian bound to its last command.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.special: Target pushed 10 ft

attacks.name: Stone Throw
attacks.special: Throws chunks of itself. Each throw reduces max HP by 5 until repaired

passives.name: Damage Immunity
passives.description: Immune to poison and psychic damage.

passives.name: Resistance
passives.description: Resists non-magical physical damage.

passives.name: Magic Resistance
passives.description: Advantage on saves versus spells.

passives.name: Immutable Form
passives.description: Immune to effects that would alter its form.

behavior.tactics: Follows last instructions given by its creator. Most Keldaran war golems guard ancient holds or mines. They do not communicate and cannot be reasoned with. They perform their duty until destroyed.
behavior.morale: Fights to destruction. Cannot flee, surrender, or negotiate.

narration.first_sighting: Stone grinds against steel somewhere ahead.
narration.attack_cue: A heavy clatter marks the swing of its arm.
narration.wounded_cue: Metal groans as a plate splits from its frame.
narration.death_cue: A long grinding crash ends in silence.
narration.ambient_cue: A steady stone scrape paces the ancient hall.

name: Saltmarsh Lurker
description: A submerged marsh predator that drags prey beneath the water.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.special: On hit: target grappled (escape DC 12). Grappled targets pulled underwater next turn

attacks.name: Tail Slap
attacks.special: Reach 10 ft

passives.name: Hold Breath
passives.description: Can hold its breath for 30 minutes. Swims 40 ft.

passives.name: Ambush from Water
passives.description: Advantage on Stealth while submerged.

passives.name: Swamp Camouflage
passives.description: Camouflages in swamp terrain.

behavior.tactics: Lies submerged near banks or fords. Grabs creatures at the water's edge and drags them under.
behavior.morale: Releases prey if it takes 10+ damage in one hit.

narration.first_sighting: A wet squelch stirs at the bank.
narration.attack_cue: Water slaps the shore as jaws snap shut.
narration.wounded_cue: A low hiss bubbles through the reeds.
narration.death_cue: A last gurgling breath rises through the water.
narration.ambient_cue: Reeds rustle and water drips into the mud.

name: Tidecaller Eel
description: A territorial coastal eel that discharges lightning through water.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.special: Target grappled (escape DC 14)

attacks.name: Lightning Discharge
attacks.special: CON save DC 13. Water only; all creatures in water within 15 ft. Recharge 5-6

passives.name: Water Breathing
passives.description: Breathes underwater. Swims 50 ft.

passives.name: Electricity Absorption
passives.description: Immune to lightning; heals HP equal to lightning damage dealt to it.

passives.name: Keen Vibration Sense
passives.description: Detects movement in water within 60 ft.

behavior.tactics: Territorial in coastal waters. Uses Lightning Discharge to stun prey, then bites grappled targets.
behavior.morale: Retreats to deep water if outmatched on shore.

narration.first_sighting: A faint electrical crackle runs across the water.
narration.attack_cue: A sharp snap breaks from the water before the discharge.
narration.wounded_cue: A wet rasp follows its thrashing tail.
narration.death_cue: The crackle fades into a final splash.
narration.ambient_cue: Water sloshes against rock beneath a low electrical hum.

name: Umbral Crawler
description: A ceiling-dwelling tunnel predator with paralytic mandibles.

attacks.name: Mandible
attacks.special: Only on grappled targets. Injects paralytic: DC 13 CON save or Paralyzed 1 minute

passives.name: Blindsight
passives.description: Blindsight 60 ft; hunts by vibration and scent. Climbs 30 ft.

passives.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
passives.description: Disadvantage in daylight.

passives.name: Pack Ambush
passives.description: First attack from hidden has advantage and deals +1d6 damage.

behavior.tactics: Hunts in packs in deep tunnels. Drops from ceilings. Targets weakest-looking creature. Uses paralytic on downed prey.
behavior.morale: Flees if 50% of pack killed.

narration.first_sighting: Chittering scratches descend from the ceiling.
narration.attack_cue: Claws scrape stone above you.
narration.wounded_cue: A thin hiss escapes its cracked chitin.
narration.death_cue: Its mandibles click once and fall silent.
narration.ambient_cue: Distant chittering rolls through the tunnel.

audio.ambient: distant chittering rolls through the tunnel.
audio.hit: a thin hiss escapes its cracked chitin.
audio.death: its mandibles click once and fall silent.

name: Deepstone Guardian
description: An ancient stone sentry bound to defend buried halls.

attacks.name: Guardian Pulse
attacks.special: CON save DC 14. Pushes all creatures 10 ft. Recharge 5-6

passives.name: Damage Immunity
passives.description: Immune to poison and psychic damage.

passives.name: Resistance
passives.description: Resists non-magical physical damage.

passives.name: Sentry Protocol
passives.description: Cannot be surprised.

passives.name: Tremorsense
passives.description: Detects creatures within 30 ft even through walls.

actives.name: Lockdown
actives.description: All doors and passages within 60 ft seal for 1 minute; STR DC 16 to force open.

behavior.tactics: Guards ancient underground structures. Activates when intruders enter its zone. Will not pursue beyond its assigned area.
behavior.morale: Fights to destruction within its zone.

narration.first_sighting: Stone grinds behind a sealed passage.
narration.attack_cue: A heavy thud shakes the floor.
narration.wounded_cue: A crack splits its grinding joints.
narration.death_cue: The grinding stops with a final stone thud.
narration.ambient_cue: A low stone hum echoes through the hall.

audio.ambient: a low stone hum echoes through the hall.
audio.attack: a heavy thud shakes the floor.
audio.hit: a crack splits its grinding joints.
audio.death: the grinding stops with a final stone thud.

name: Dire Bear
description: An enormous territorial bear that grapples prey.

attacks.name: Claw
attacks.special: Reach 10 ft

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.special: On hit: target grappled (escape DC 16). Can only bite grappled targets on subsequent rounds

attacks.name: Maul
attacks.special: Auto-hit only against grappled targets. The full-body crush

multiattack: 2 attacks — one Claw and one Bite

passives.name: Keen Smell
passives.description: Advantage on Perception by smell.

passives.name: Thick Hide
passives.description: Resists cold damage.

passives.name: Territorial Rage
passives.description: Below 25% HP: advantage on all attacks and +2 damage.

behavior.tactics: Extremely territorial. Charges largest threat. Grapples and mauls. A dire bear in its rage state is one of the most dangerous natural encounters in the game.
behavior.morale: Fights to death defending territory. Outside territory: retreats below 50% HP unless cubs nearby.
behavior.group_size: Solitary or mother with 1-2 cubs (cubs are non-combatants)

narration.first_sighting: A deep growl carries through the trees.
narration.attack_cue: A heavy snort precedes the charge.
narration.wounded_cue: A guttural groan rumbles from its chest.
narration.death_cue: One last breath rasps out among the leaves.
narration.ambient_cue: A rank scent drifts between broken branches.

audio.ambient: a rank scent drifts between broken branches.
audio.attack: a heavy snort precedes the charge.
audio.hit: a guttural groan rumbles from its chest.
audio.death: one last breath rasps out among the leaves.

name: Troll
description: A regenerating brute that fears flame.
multiattack: 3 attacks — one Bite and two Claw

passives.name: Regeneration
passives.description: Regains 5 HP at start of each turn; stops for 1 round after fire or acid damage.

passives.name: Keen Smell
passives.description: Keen smell.

passives.name: Loathsome Limbs
passives.description: Severed limbs act independently for 1 round; flavor only.

behavior.tactics: Aggressive but dim. Charges in, attacks whatever is closest. Does not use tactics. Will switch targets if current target deals fire damage.
behavior.morale: Fights while regenerating. Flees if on fire.

narration.first_sighting: A wet grunt comes from beyond the marsh.
narration.attack_cue: Claws scrape rock as it lunges.
narration.wounded_cue: A pained growl turns to a hiss.
narration.death_cue: A final groan bubbles into silence.
narration.ambient_cue: A foul stink hangs over the path.

audio.ambient: a foul stink hangs over the path.
audio.attack: claws scrape rock as it lunges.
audio.hit: a pained growl turns to a hiss.
audio.death: a final groan bubbles into silence.

name: Bandit Captain
description: A practiced road commander who fights behind bodyguards.
multiattack: 2 attacks with Longsword or 2 Crossbow shots

passives.name: Leadership Aura
passives.description: Bandits within 30 ft gain +1 to attack rolls.

passives.name: Cunning Action
passives.description: Can Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.

actives.name: Rally
actives.description: All allied bandits within 30 ft regain 1d8 HP.

actives.name: Dirty Fighting
actives.description: Advantage on next attack; on hit, target Blinded 1 round.

behavior.tactics: Stays behind bodyguards. Uses crossbow at range, switches to sword when pressed. Commands bandits tactically — has them flank, focus fire, and retreat when losing.
behavior.morale: Flees when last bodyguard falls. Surrenders if cornered and outmatched — will offer information or treasure for life.

narration.first_sighting: A sharp whistle calls hidden bandits to order.
narration.attack_cue: A crossbow twang cuts through the shouting.
narration.wounded_cue: A harsh grunt follows the blow.
narration.death_cue: A last breath rattles under the retreating footsteps.
narration.ambient_cue: Boots scrape gravel while low voices confer.

audio.ambient: boots scrape gravel while low voices confer.
audio.attack: a crossbow twang cuts through the shouting.
audio.hit: a harsh grunt follows the blow.
audio.death: a last breath rattles under the retreating footsteps.

name: Thunderbird
description: A storm predator that carries prey into the sky.

attacks.name: Talons
attacks.special: Target grappled (escape DC 15). Thunderbird can fly while grappling — carries target

attacks.name: Lightning Breath
attacks.special: DEX save DC 15. Half on success. Recharge 5-6. The signature attack

multiattack: 2 attacks — one Beak and one Talons

passives.name: Flyby
passives.description: No opportunity attacks when flying away. Flies 80 ft.

passives.name: Lightning Absorption
passives.description: Immune to lightning; heals equal to lightning damage dealt to it.

passives.name: Storm Sense
passives.description: Senses storms 6 hours ahead; fights more commonly during storms.

behavior.tactics: Apex predator of mountain and steppe skies. Dives from extreme altitude, uses Lightning Breath on groups, picks up isolated targets with talons. Intelligent enough to avoid large armed groups.
behavior.morale: Retreats to altitude if badly wounded. Returns when healed. Does not fight to the death unless defending nest.

narration.first_sighting: Thunder cracks above the mountain pass.
narration.attack_cue: A piercing screech precedes the dive.
narration.wounded_cue: A crackle falters through its ragged breath.
narration.death_cue: A fading screech trails into the wind.
narration.ambient_cue: A low thunder crack rolls overhead.

audio.ambient: a low thunder rumble circles overhead.
audio.attack: a piercing screech precedes the dive.
audio.hit: a crackle falters through its ragged breath.
audio.death: a fading screech trails into the wind.

name: Mawling
description: Probes defenses, feints, retreats from strong resistance, returns from different angle. In groups of 3+, one flanks while others engage. Uses Lunge to grab isolated targets.

attacks.name: Claw
attacks.special: Reach 10 ft (unnaturally long limbs)

attacks.name: Dissolution Maw
attacks.special: DC 13 CON save or item in hand takes 1d4 durability damage

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.special: Recharge 5-6. Move 15 ft toward target and strike with Claw with advantage; hit grapples target.

multiattack: 2 attacks — one Claw and one Dissolution Maw

passives.name: Unsettling Silence
passives.description: Mawlings make no vocalizations. Advantage on Stealth in low-light.

passives.name: Dissolution Field
passives.description: Creatures starting turn grappled by a mawling take 1d6 necrotic automatically.

passives.name: Adaptive Learning
passives.description: If the same tactic is used against this mawling twice in one encounter, it gains advantage on saves/AC against that tactic for the rest of the fight.

actives.name: Lunge
actives.description: Move 15 ft toward target + Claw with advantage. Hit: target grappled (STR DC 13 escape).

actives.name: Scatter
actives.description: Requires 3+ mawlings. All mawlings reposition 15 ft without provoking reactions. Coordinated flank.

hollow.veil_effect: Natural sounds distort within 15 ft. Footsteps echo wrong. Combat sounds arrive delayed.

behavior.tactics: Probes defenses, feints, retreats from strong resistance, returns from different angle. In groups of 3+, one flanks while others engage. Uses Lunge to grab isolated targets.
behavior.morale: retreats_at_25_percent_if_alone

narration.first_sighting: A scrape marks three footfalls where there should be two. A nearly human shape approaches on joints that bend backward, with a tear where its face should be.
narration.attack_cue: A wet rasp tears through the air as its hand reaches too far. The air shimmers behind it.
narration.wounded_cue: A thin crackle follows the mawling as it staggers and flickers, momentarily transparent.
narration.death_cue: A soft crunch folds its limbs inward. A dark smear remains, carrying the smell of absence.
narration.ambient_cue: A scrape counts three steps where there should be two. A pause follows, then silence.

name: Hollow Weaver
description: Anchors to a location and warps space. Left undisturbed for 1 hour, converts a building into a spatial labyrinth.

attacks.name: Spatial Lash
attacks.special: The space between the weaver and target compresses violently

passives.name: Spatial Distortion
passives.description: Warps space in a 30 ft radius. Ranged attacks have disadvantage. Movement through the zone costs double; terrain is perception-based, not physical.

passives.name: Anchored
passives.description: Attaches to a surface and does not move voluntarily. It must be approached.

passives.name: Fragile Form
passives.description: Vulnerable to all physical damage. Easy to kill if reached.

actives.name: Rearrange
actives.description: Shift one doorway, corridor, or passage within 30 ft to a different real location. Creatures in the passage arrive at the new destination.

actives.name: Spatial Fold
actives.description: Target within 30 ft: WIS save DC 13 or teleport 30 ft in random direction. If destination is solid matter, take 2d6 force and move to nearest open space.

hollow.veil_effect: Reverb characteristics change — small rooms echo like cathedrals, large spaces go acoustically dead. The player's own footsteps sound wrong.

behavior.tactics: Anchors to a location and warps space. Left undisturbed for 1 hour, converts a building into a spatial labyrinth.
behavior.morale: fights_until_destroyed

narration.first_sighting: A low hum bends the echo in the corridor. A doorway that was ten feet away now seems thirty, and the passage bends around something anchored ahead.
narration.attack_cue: A compressed-air thud strikes as the space between you and the weaver folds.
narration.wounded_cue: A wavering hum breaks as the room briefly snaps back to normal dimensions, then warps again.
narration.death_cue: A sharp snap sounds like a taut wire breaking. Walls settle back into place and the room sounds normal again.
narration.ambient_cue: A low glass-rim hum carries through the building. Each footstep returns from the wrong direction.

name: Hollowed Knight
description: Holds chokepoints, sends lesser Hollow to probe, flanks, and targets healers and casters first.

attacks.name: Corrupted Blade
attacks.special: Plus 1d6 necrotic. On crit: DC 14 CON save or Stage 1 Hollowed condition.

attacks.name: Shield Slam
attacks.special: DC 14 STR save or knocked prone.

passives.name: Remnant Tactics
passives.description: Uses combat techniques from former life. Takes Dodge when outnumbered and uses terrain for advantage.

passives.name: Corrupted Resilience
passives.description: Resists non-magical slashing, piercing, and bludgeoning. Magical weapons deal full damage.

passives.name: Fragment Voice
passives.description: Occasionally speaks from its former life. First time former allies hear this: WIS save DC 12 or Shaken, disadvantage on next attack. Cosmetic thereafter.

actives.name: Command Lesser
actives.description: As a bonus action, direct up to 4 Drift or Rend Hollow within 60 ft to focus a target or reposition.

actives.name: Dissolution Strike
actives.description: Next attack adds 3d6 necrotic and ignores resistance. On hit, 5 ft of ground becomes corrupted terrain for 1 minute.

actives.name: Unholy Fortitude
actives.description: At 0 HP, CON save DC 10. On success drop to 1 HP; DC increases by 5 each time.

hollow.veil_effect: 30 ft radius — temperature drops, shadows fall wrong, sounds of the former person's life occasionally echo.

behavior.tactics: Holds chokepoints, sends lesser Hollow to probe, flanks, and targets healers and casters first.
behavior.morale: fights_to_destruction

narration.first_sighting: Armor creaks with an unnaturally regular gait. Ashmark issue plate closes in, its wearer moving with practiced precision and a head that turns too far.
narration.attack_cue: A blade whistles with a soldier’s practiced timing. Necrotic energy sizzles along its edge.
narration.wounded_cue: A confused human breath catches beneath the helmet as the knight staggers. Then the bellows rhythm returns.
narration.death_cue: Armor clatters to the ground. One nearly human breath follows, then silence.
narration.ambient_cue: Armor creaks in measured steps. Beneath it, breathing rasps like bellows.

name: Veilrender
description: Advances 100 yards per day converting territory. In combat stands ground and uses area denial. Radiant damage or Veil Ward suppresses regeneration.

attacks.name: Crushing Mass
attacks.special: Push target 10 ft. Structures take double damage.

attacks.name: Corruption Wave
attacks.special: 30 ft cone. Half damage on successful DC 16 CON save; failed save causes Poisoned for 1 round.

passives.name: Corruption Field
passives.description: Permanent 60 ft radius. Creatures starting turn inside take 1d4 necrotic (CON save DC 14 negates). Organic matter degrades; plants die, water darkens, stone becomes brittle.

passives.name: Regeneration
passives.description: Regains 10 HP at start of each turn. Radiant damage or Veil Ward suppresses for 1 round.

passives.name: Siege Monster
passives.description: Deals double damage to structures and objects.

passives.name: Massive
passives.description: Cannot be grappled, restrained, or knocked prone by anything smaller than Huge. Occupies 15 ft × 15 ft.

actives.name: Reality Crush
actives.description: 20 ft radius centered on veilrender: DEX save DC 16. Failure: 4d8 force and prone; success: half damage, not prone. Ground cracks and structures collapse.

actives.name: Corruption Pulse
actives.description: 60 ft radius: CON save DC 16. Failure: 3d6 necrotic and Stage 1 Hollowed; success: half, no Hollowed.

reactions.name: Absorb Magic
reactions.description: When targeted by a spell, absorb it: no effect, and regain HP equal to Focus cost × 3. Radiant spells bypass this.

hollow.veil_effect: Sound doesn't travel correctly in 60 ft radius. Voices sound distant. Your own voice sounds muffled. Acoustic space is rewritten.

behavior.tactics: Advances 100 yards per day converting territory. In combat stands ground and uses area denial. Radiant damage or Veil Ward suppresses regeneration.
behavior.morale: fights_until_destroyed

narration.first_sighting: A subsonic hum builds over minutes until your own voice sounds far away. A building-sized mass advances through an area where every sound arrives wrong.
narration.attack_cue: A vast thud presses down as the mass falls forward. The air muffles your scream.
narration.wounded_cue: A crack snaps across its surface, followed by a low grinding sound as the gap seals again.
narration.death_cue: A deep groan swallows the field. Silence hangs over the hollow it leaves in the earth.
narration.ambient_cue: A low hum presses beneath conversation. Your companion’s voice sounds distant at arm’s length.

audio.ambient: HLW-002 heavy subsonic drone and acoustic distortion

name: The Choir
description: A moving zone of auditory hallucination with no visible form.

attacks.name: Memory Scream
attacks.special: WIS save DC 18; failed save also Stunned 1 round. The Choir rips out and distorts a memory.

attacks.name: Dissonant Chord
attacks.special: CON save DC 18 or Deafened 1 minute.

passives.name: No Physical Form
passives.description: Immune to slashing, piercing, and bludgeoning; only psychic, radiant, thunder, or force harms it. Cannot be grappled, restrained, or targeted by touch spells.

passives.name: Aura of Lost Voices
passives.description: Within 200 yards, WIS save DC 15 at each turn start or lose concentration. Insight, Perception, and Investigation have disadvantage outside combat.

passives.name: Memory Predator
passives.description: Gravitates toward strong fear, grief, love, or rage; emotionally engaged creatures become priority targets.

passives.name: Resonance Core
passives.description: Find the hidden core with DC 18 Perception or Arcana. Destroying the core destroys the Choir.

actives.name: Stolen Melody
actives.description: Recharge 5-6. Mimics a loved or lost voice. WIS save DC 20 or Charmed for 1d4 rounds, moving toward the voice. The DM speaks in that voice.

actives.name: Cacophony
actives.description: 1/encounter. All within 60 ft make CON save DC 18: fail 4d8 thunder, Deafened, Stunned 1 round; success half damage and Deafened.

actives.name: Silence Void
actives.description: 1/encounter. 30 ft radius absolute silence for 3 rounds; no verbal spellcasting or communication.

reactions.name: Harmonic Shield
reactions.description: When targeted by a spell with a verbal component, caster WIS save DC 16 or spell targets caster instead.

hollow.veil_effect: Sound is weaponized; every voice in the zone, including companions, may be false.

behavior.tactics: Drifts toward settlements and strong emotion; find its core while surviving the 200-yard aura.
behavior.morale: fights_until_destroyed

narration.first_sighting: A hum carries a familiar voice, then others, each a little wrong and louder.
narration.attack_cue: A screech carries a torn memory back through static.
narration.wounded_cue: A hum stutters into silence, then returns angrier.
narration.death_cue: A hum becomes one pure note; every stolen voice speaks its last word, then silence.
narration.ambient_cue: A hum of almost remembered music calls your name.

audio.ambient: Layered whispers, distorted familiar music, HLW-005 false source whispers
audio.attack: Layered whispers, distorted familiar music, HLW-005 false source whispers
audio.hit: Layered whispers, distorted familiar music, HLW-005 false source whispers
audio.death: Layered whispers, distorted familiar music, HLW-005 false source whispers

name: The Still
description: A beautiful square-mile zone that absorbs those who stay.

attacks.name: Serenity's Touch
attacks.special: Auto-hit (no roll) from any zone surface. WIS save DC 20 or Charmed for 1 hour; sit, rest, and refuse to leave.

attacks.name: Perfect Memory
attacks.special: WIS save DC 20 or take no actions next turn, lost in a perfect memory.

passives.name: Zone Entity
passives.description: Occupies about 1 square mile. Six hidden anchors hold 40-45 HP each, AC 20. Damage must target anchors; destroy all six to destroy the Still.

passives.name: Paradise Trap
passives.description: Entering creatures WIS save DC 18 or Charmed and unwilling to leave; re-save hourly with cumulative +1 bonus.

passives.name: Gentle Absorption
passives.description: After 24 continuous Charmed hours, lose 1d4 from highest attribute per day; at 0 in any attribute, absorbed.

passives.name: No Hostility
passives.description: Does not attack creatures unless they try to destroy it; passive absorption continues.

actives.name: Illusory Perfection
actives.description: 1/round free action: tailored loved one, home, or happy memory. Investigation DC 22 sees through it.

actives.name: Rejection
actives.description: Recharge 5-6 when anchor attacked. Within 30 ft of anchor WIS save DC 20: fail teleported to zone edge; success remain but Stunned 1 round.

actives.name: Final Stillness
actives.description: 1/encounter when 4+ anchors destroyed. All in zone WIS save DC 22: fail Stunned 1d4 rounds and Charmed; success half stun, no charm.

hollow.veil_effect: Perfect birdsong, water and warmth make paradise sound like a trap.

behavior.tactics: Lures creatures with comfort and absorbs them slowly; destroying each anchor erases part of its beauty.
behavior.morale: cannot_flee

narration.first_sighting: A whistle of impossibly perfect birdsong rises over the grass; every instinct says stay.
narration.attack_cue: A whistle changes key as an anchor is threatened.
narration.wounded_cue: A crack runs through an anchor; a sector greys and falls silent.
narration.death_cue: A hum fades with the beauty, revealing corrupted earth and those it consumed.
narration.ambient_cue: A hum settles into precisely what you want to hear.

audio.ambient: Perfect nature layers peel away with anchors; final HLW-002 drone
audio.attack: Perfect nature layers peel away with anchors; final HLW-002 drone
audio.hit: Perfect nature layers peel away with anchors; final HLW-002 drone
audio.death: Perfect nature layers peel away with anchors; final HLW-002 drone

name: The Architect
description: A builder of impossible structures that weaponizes its domain.

attacks.name: Construct Slam
attacks.special: Plus 2d6 force. Push target 15 ft; collision with a wall deals 2d6 bludgeoning.

attacks.name: Geometry Strike
attacks.special: A structural fragment hurls itself. Auto-hit against targets touching the Architect's structures.

passives.name: Architect's Domain
passives.description: Within 0.5 mile, walls, floors and ceilings shift each round; other creatures treat it as difficult terrain.

passives.name: Incorporeal Movement
passives.description: Passes through its own structures, not natural terrain or other structures.

passives.name: Legendary Resistance
passives.description: 3/day: turn a failed save into a success.

passives.name: Alien Intelligence
passives.description: INT 22; plans, adapts, anticipates, and avoids repeating failed strategies.

actives.name: Reshape
actives.description: 1/round free action: create, move or destroy a 20 ft × 20 ft wall, floor, or ceiling section within 120 ft. Below half HP, 2/round. As a legendary action, Reshape costs 2 of 3/round.

actives.name: Entomb
actives.description: Recharge 5-6. One creature within 60 ft STR save DC 20 or Restrained in a sealed chamber, taking 3d8 bludgeoning per round. Escape STR DC 20 or 30+ damage to one AC 19, 30 HP wall.

actives.name: Cathedral
actives.description: 1/encounter. Create a 60 ft radius cathedral; DEX save DC 20 or 4d10 force. Architect gains +2 AC and saves until it leaves or dies.

actives.name: Summon Constructs
actives.description: 1/encounter. Animate 2d4 minions for 1 minute: HP 20, AC 16, speed 30 ft, slam +8 for 1d8+5 bludgeoning.

actives.name: Shift Wall
actives.description: Legendary action, cost 1 of 3/round: move wall up to 30 ft.

actives.name: Geometry Strike
actives.description: Legendary action, cost 2 of 3/round: make one Geometry Strike attack.

reactions.name: Reactive Architecture
reactions.description: On ranged attack or spell, raise a wall (AC 19, 30 HP) as reaction; wall takes hit.

hollow.veil_effect: Construction sounds arise from no tool or worker: patient scraping and rhythmic percussion.

behavior.tactics: Builds constantly; when threatened uses every surface as a weapon. Below half HP Reshape rises to 2/round.
behavior.morale: fights_until_destroyed

narration.first_sighting: A scrape of stone rises as new bridges connect nothing; no worker is near.
narration.attack_cue: A grind of stone announces a wall moving deliberately toward you.
narration.wounded_cue: A crack splits a tower; construction sounds turn urgent.
narration.death_cue: A groan passes through every structure as it collapses; the final building sound fades.
narration.ambient_cue: A scrape of stone and rhythmic building sounds arise from empty air.

audio.hit: HLW-008 slow pulse, stone grinding, force impacts, collapsing structures
